summary: Flood has curves built from transferred and our judgment evidence (2 parts); hurricane wind and wildfire have curves that are our judgment (2 parts each); hail and convective wind have no cell yet. 3 parts of the battery plant have no curve under any hazard: MV, collection and controls, civil works and fieldwork.
summary_v0: Flood, hurricane wind and wildfire have curves for batteries, all from transferred or policy evidence (T3–T4); hail and convective wind have none; nobody has yet searched for field reports.

hazards.label: Heat
hazards.effect_note: The twin's heat leads (ageing, derating, chiller capacity) work through performance, not physical damage; pointer to the outage-as-performance work, no curve (discussion 04 §6).

hazards.label: Icing
hazards.effect_note: Two leads in the twin: snow load on the venting panels (physical, L) and cold limiting the charge rate until heated (performance, L). No hazard cell; the C-172 snow-and-ice reasoning applies (discussion 04 §6).

hazards.label: Lightning
hazards.effect_note: No hazard cell exists; the twin carries Medium surge leads on the electronics (discussion 04 §6).
